profile_text.body:
Celestica Inc. describes itself as a technology leader with expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and platform solutions. According to its website, the company engineers, designs and manufactures the backbone of AI and cloud technology, and it enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud. It says it advances technologies in high-growth markets and helps customers achieve a competitive advantage through a global network.

Celestica Inc. is a public company headquartered in Toronto, trading under the ticker CLS, with SEC Central Index Key 0001030894.
